header.title: Open Safety Studio
header.proof1: Dutch Working Conditions Decree · Building Decree
header.heroAlt: Open Safety Studio: health and safety plan for new housing, with the fall-from-height risks and their source, technical, organisational and PPE measures, and the legal basis on the right
header.label: Construction safety
header.tagline: A health and safety plan in minutes instead of days
header.desc: Pick a template for your type of project and you start with the risks and measures that come with it. Weigh risks in a matrix, fill in the BLVC plan and the safe-maintenance checklist, and always see which article of law applies.

meta.description: Free browser app for construction safety plans: a health and safety plan from a template, a risk matrix, a BLVC plan and a safe-maintenance checklist, with the legal basis alongside and a printable report.
meta.title: Open Safety Studio — OpenAEC Foundation

template.alt: Template for new housing with typical duration, number of people, points of attention and the selected risk modules
template.title: Don't start from a blank page
template.desc: Choose from ten templates, from housing and high-rise to demolition, civil works and hydraulic engineering. Each template sets up the matching risk modules, with points of attention for that kind of work. Tick modules on or off before you start.

matrix.alt: Five-by-five risk matrix with four risks, and on the right a risk with likelihood 4, severity 5 and three measures
matrix.title: See straight away which risk comes first
matrix.desc: Rate each risk on likelihood and severity. The matrix runs from green to dark red and puts the risk in its place. Record measures for each risk, with a person responsible and a date.

report.alt: Report preview of the health and safety plan with a table of score, risk, likelihood and severity for each risk module
report.title: A plan you can print and share
report.desc: With one click your health and safety plan becomes a tidy report: cover page, special risks and, per module, the risks with their measures. Print it or save it as a PDF for the project file.

blvc.alt: BLVC plan with tabs for accessibility, liveability, safety and communication, filled in for a fictional housing project
blvc.title: Keep the neighbourhood accessible and informed
blvc.desc: When you work in public space, describe for each letter what you arrange: traffic diversions and emergency services, noise and dust, fencing and signage, and how residents get information and a point of contact.

maintenance.alt: Safe-maintenance checklist with ten items, five ticked with a note, and the legal basis on the right
maintenance.title: A building that can be maintained safely later
maintenance.desc: Use a ten-point checklist to verify that the roof, facade, gutters, installations and lift can be reached safely. Keep a register of fixed provisions such as anchor points and guardrails, with inspection date and status.

notice.text: Test version: your input is not saved yet. Finish your plan in one go and print it or save it as a PDF.

whatsnew.label: New in v0.1
whatsnew.title: Templates and a report
whatsnew.desc: The first version is online. You start a health and safety plan from a template and turn it into a printable report.

files.a: None yet. You start a plan from a template or fill it in yourself. Opening files and reading an IFC model will come in a later version.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. Open Safety Studio runs in the browser, with no account. A desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux is in preparation but cannot be downloaded yet.

price.q: What does Open Safety Studio cost?
price.a: Nothing. The app is free, with no account or subscription.

save.q: In which format is my work saved?
save.a: Not yet: in this test version your input only stays while the window is open. Finish the plan and save the report as a PDF via Print. Saving as a project file will come in a later version.

systems.q: Which systems does it run on?
systems.a: In any modern browser on Windows, macOS and Linux. The app is made for a large screen.

practice.a: Yes. The health and safety plan follows article 2.28 of the Dutch Working Conditions Decree, the special risks come from Annex II of the European construction sites directive and the safe-maintenance checklist refers to the Dutch Building Decree and article 2.30 of the Working Conditions Decree. Measures follow the occupational hygiene hierarchy.

required.q: When is a health and safety plan required?
required.a: For work with a special risk from Annex II, or when the work lasts more than 30 working days with more than 20 people at once, or takes more than 500 person-days. The app shows this next to the plan.

coordinator.q: Does it replace the health and safety coordinator?
coordinator.a: No. The templates give a solid start, but the coordinator judges which risks and measures apply to this project and remains responsible for the plan.

ifc.q: Does it work with IFC models?
ifc.a: Not yet. There is an IFC tab, but importing, exporting and checking a model will come in a later version.
